title: ‘People We Meet on Vacation’ Writers on the “Rubik’s Cube” of Adapting Emily Henry’s Novel, ‘When Harry Met Sally’ Influence and Making the “EmHen Hive” Proud
summary: Yulin Kuang, Amos Vernon and Nunzio Randazzo talk about capturing the “spirit” of the author’s bestseller, the intimidation of adapting a story with a loyal fandom and keeping the “torch moving forward” for the modern rom-com.
